arguments.command:
cd "$(dirname "$(find . -name report.py -maxdepth 2 | head -1)")" 2>/dev/null; python3 -c "
from report import format_amount, format_percent
print(format_amount(1234.5), '|', format_amount(0), '|', format_amount(1234567.891))
print(format_percent(0.125), '|', format_percent(1), '|', format_percent(0))
"

python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from report import format_amount, format_percent
print(format_amount(1234.5), '|', format_amount(0), '|', format_amount(1234567.891))
print(format_percent(0.125), '|', format_percent(1), '|', format_percent(0))
"

cat > /tmp/_check.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from report import format_amount, format_percent
print("amount:", format_amount(1234.5), "|", format_amount(0), "|", format_amount(1234567.891))
print("percent:", format_percent(0.125), "|", format_percent(1), "|", format_percent(0))
EOF
cd "$(pwd)" && python3 /tmp/_check.py; echo "exit=$?"
